test_cases.title: Full refund of a Visa sale returns money to the same Visa card
preconditions: Store STORE-0123, register 04, cashier logged in
Sale TXN-2001 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (Product SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
steps: 1. Start a refund and scan the receipt for TXN-2001
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved; refund receipt shows $40.00 to Visa ending 4242; no cash or store credit issued

test_cases.title: Full refund of a cash sale returns cash
preconditions: Sale TXN-2002 on 2026-10-20 for $25.00 (SKU-1002 x1) paid in cash
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved; refund receipt shows $25.00 tender type Cash; cash drawer opens; no card refund or store credit issued

test_cases.title: Cashier cannot refund a Visa sale to cash
preconditions: Sale TXN-2003 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
steps: 3. Try to change the refund tender to Cash
test_cases.expected: POS does not allow Cash as the refund tender; refund receipt shows $40.00 to Visa ending 4242; cash drawer does not open

test_cases.title: Refund allowed 10 days after purchase
preconditions: Sale TXN-2004 on 2026-10-18 for $30.00 (SKU-1003 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Refund performed on 2026-10-28
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved; $30.00 refunded to Mastercard ending 5454

test_cases.title: Refund allowed on day 29 after purchase
preconditions: Sale TXN-2005 on 2026-09-29 for $30.00 (SKU-1003 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Refund performed on 2026-10-28
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved; $30.00 refunded to Mastercard ending 5454

test_cases.title: Refund on day 30 after purchase (inclusivity to be confirmed)
preconditions: Sale TXN-2006 on 2026-09-28 for $30.00 (SKU-1003 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Refund performed on 2026-10-28
test_cases.expected: Record what the POS shows and compare with the answer to open question 1. If day 30 is inside the window: refund approved and $30.00 refunded to Mastercard ending 5454. If not: refund blocked and no money moved

test_cases.title: Refund blocked on day 31 after purchase
preconditions: Sale TXN-2007 on 2026-09-27 for $30.00 (SKU-1003 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Refund performed on 2026-10-28
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund and shows it is outside the refund window; no money refunded to any tender; no refund message sent to SAP

test_cases.title: Refund blocked 60 days after purchase
preconditions: Sale TXN-2008 on 2026-08-29 for $30.00 (SKU-1003 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 5454
Refund performed on 2026-10-28
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund and shows it is outside the refund window; no money refunded to any tender; no refund message sent to SAP

test_cases.title: Full refund of a two-tender sale is refunded last tender first
preconditions: Payment order: 1st Gift Card GC-7788 $30.00, 2nd Visa ending 4242 $70.00
steps: 4. Open the refund record and check the tender sequence
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved; refund record lists Visa ending 4242 $70.00 first, then Gift Card GC-7788 $30.00; total refunded $100.00

test_cases.title: Full refund of a three-tender sale follows reverse payment order
preconditions: Payment order: 1st Cash $20.00, 2nd Gift Card GC-7789 $30.00, 3rd Mastercard ending 5454 $40.00
steps: 4. Open the refund record and check the tender sequence
test_cases.expected: Refund record lists Mastercard ending 5454 $40.00 first, then Gift Card GC-7789 $30.00, then Cash $20.00; total refunded $90.00

test_cases.title: Cashier cannot refund a split-tender sale entirely to one tender
preconditions: Payment order: 1st Gift Card GC-7790 $30.00, 2nd Visa ending 4242 $70.00
steps: 3. Try to send the full $100.00 to Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS does not allow $100.00 to the Visa; refund record shows Visa ending 4242 $70.00 and Gift Card GC-7790 $30.00 in that order

test_cases.title: Partial refund of one line item
preconditions: Sale TXN-2012 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00: SKU-2001 $25.00 and SKU-2002 $15.00, paid by Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $15.00; $15.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242; SKU-2001 still shows as refundable for $25.00

test_cases.title: Two partial refunds that add up exactly to the original amount are allowed
preconditions: Sale TXN-2013 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00: SKU-2001 $25.00 and SKU-2002 $15.00, paid by Visa ending 4242
SKU-2002 ($15.00) already refunded from this sale
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved for $25.00; total refunded on TXN-2013 is $40.00, equal to the original; no line items left refundable

test_cases.title: Same line item cannot be refunded twice
preconditions: Sale TXN-2014 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00: SKU-2001 $25.00 and SKU-2002 $15.00, paid by Visa ending 4242
SKU-2001 ($25.00) already refunded from this sale
steps: 2. Try to select line item SKU-2001 ($25.00) again
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund of SKU-2001; total refunded on TXN-2014 stays $25.00; no new money refunded to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: No further refund after a sale is fully refunded
preconditions: Sale TXN-2015 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
TXN-2015 already fully refunded ($40.00)
steps: 2. Try to select SKU-1001 for refund
test_cases.expected: POS blocks the refund; total refunded on TXN-2015 stays $40.00; no money refunded to any tender

test_cases.title: Refund of $499.99 needs no manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2016 on 2026-10-20 for $499.99 (SKU-3001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS does not ask for manager approval; refund approved; $499.99 refunded to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: Refund of exactly $500.00 needs no manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2017 on 2026-10-20 for $500.00 (SKU-3002 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS does not ask for manager approval (BRD says over $500, see open question 4); refund approved; $500.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242

test_cases.title: Refund of $500.01 asks for manager approval
preconditions: Sale TXN-2018 on 2026-10-20 for $500.01 (SKU-3003 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
test_cases.expected: POS shows a manager approval prompt at the register before the refund completes; no money refunded until approval is given

test_cases.title: Refund of $750.00 completes after manager approves
preconditions: Sale TXN-2019 on 2026-10-20 for $750.00 (SKU-3004 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
Manager MGR-01 available at the register
steps: 4. At the approval prompt, manager MGR-01 approves
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved after manager approval; $750.00 refunded to Visa ending 4242; refund record shows approver MGR-01

test_cases.title: Refund of $750.00 is not issued when manager declines
preconditions: Sale TXN-2020 on 2026-10-20 for $750.00 (SKU-3004 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
Manager MGR-01 available at the register
steps: 4. At the approval prompt, manager MGR-01 declines
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund not completed; no money refunded to Visa ending 4242 or any other tender; no refund message sent to SAP

test_cases.title: Refund to an expired card is issued as store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2021 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 1111
Visa ending 1111 set up as expired in the payment test environment
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund issued as store credit; $40.00 store credit issued; no refund sent to Visa ending 1111

test_cases.title: Refund to a closed card is issued as store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2022 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Mastercard ending 2222
Mastercard ending 2222 set up as closed in the payment test environment
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund issued as store credit; $40.00 store credit issued; no refund sent to Mastercard ending 2222

test_cases.title: Refund to an active card is not converted to store credit
preconditions: Sale TXN-2023 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
Visa ending 4242 is active in the payment test environment
test_cases.expected: POS shows refund approved to Visa ending 4242; $40.00 refunded to the card; no store credit issued

test_cases.title: SAP refund message contains all required fields with correct values
preconditions: Sale TXN-2024 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242 at STORE-0123
Access to SAP inbound message log
steps: 3. Confirm refund and note the refund ID and confirm time shown on the POS
4. Open the SAP inbound log and find the message for that refund ID
test_cases.expected: One SAP message received with refundId = the POS refund ID, originalTxnId = TXN-2024, amount = 40.00, tenderType = Visa, storeId = STORE-0123, timestamp = the refund time

test_cases.title: SAP message for a partial refund carries the partial amount
preconditions: Sale TXN-2025 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00: SKU-2001 $25.00 and SKU-2002 $15.00, paid by Visa ending 4242 at STORE-0123
steps: 3. Confirm refund and note the refund ID
4. Find the message in the SAP inbound log
test_cases.expected: SAP message has amount = 15.00 (not 40.00), originalTxnId = TXN-2025, tenderType = Visa, storeId = STORE-0123

test_cases.title: SAP receives the refund message within 5 minutes
preconditions: Sale TXN-2026 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
SAP endpoint healthy
POS and SAP clocks synced
steps: 3. Note the confirm time on the POS (T0)
4. Note the SAP inbound log receive time (T1)
test_cases.expected: T1 minus T0 is 5:00 minutes or less; test fails if the message arrives after 5:00 or not at all

test_cases.title: No SAP message when the refund is cancelled before confirm
preconditions: Sale TXN-2027 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 (SKU-1001 x1) paid by Visa ending 4242
steps: 4. Wait 5 minutes and check the SAP inbound log for TXN-2027
test_cases.expected: No refund issued; no SAP refund message with originalTxnId = TXN-2027

test_cases.title: No retries and no error log when the first SAP send succeeds
preconditions: Sale TXN-2028 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 paid by Visa ending 4242
SAP endpoint healthy
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2028 in full ($40.00) and confirm
2. Check POS send log for the refund ID
test_cases.expected: POS send log shows 1 attempt, status success; 0 retries; no error log entry for the refund ID

test_cases.title: SAP send succeeds on the 1st retry
preconditions: Sale TXN-2029 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 paid by Visa ending 4242
SAP stub set to fail the 1st call and accept the 2nd
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2029 in full ($40.00) and confirm
2. Check POS send log for the refund ID
3. Check SAP inbound log and POS error log
test_cases.expected: POS send log shows 1 failed attempt then 1 successful retry; SAP has exactly 1 message for the refund ID; no error log entry

test_cases.title: SAP send succeeds on the 3rd (last) retry
preconditions: Sale TXN-2030 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 paid by Visa ending 4242
SAP stub set to fail the first 3 calls and accept the 4th
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2030 in full ($40.00) and confirm
2. Check POS send log for the refund ID
3. Check SAP inbound log and POS error log
test_cases.expected: POS send log shows initial attempt + 3 retries, last one successful; SAP has exactly 1 message for the refund ID; no error log entry

test_cases.title: All 3 retries fail: error log written and no 4th retry
preconditions: Sale TXN-2031 on 2026-10-20 for $40.00 paid by Visa ending 4242
SAP stub set to fail every call
steps: 1. Refund TXN-2031 in full ($40.00) and confirm
2. Wait until the POS stops sending
3. Check POS send log for the refund ID
test_cases.expected: POS send log shows initial attempt + exactly 3 retries, all failed, and no further attempts; 1 error log entry for the refund ID; SAP has no message for the refund ID

open_questions: R2: Is day 30 inside the window? Is the purchase date counted as day 0 or day 1, and which time zone decides the date (store or server)?
R2: What exact message should the POS show when a refund is outside 30 days? Can a manager override it?
R3: For a partial refund of a split-tender sale, how is the amount split? Does the last tender get refunded up to its full paid amount before the earlier tender gets anything?
R5: Does 'over $500' mean a refund of exactly $500.00 needs no approval? Is the limit checked per refund or on the total refunded for the sale?
R5: How does the manager approve (badge, PIN, password)? What happens if approval times out?
R6: If only one tender in a split-tender sale is an expired or closed card, does only that portion become store credit? In what form is store credit issued (gift card, voucher, account)?
R6: How does the POS know a card is expired or closed (card date on file, or a decline from the processor at refund time)?
R7: Is the 5 minutes measured from refund confirm on the POS to receipt in SAP? What format and time zone is the timestamp? What tenderType value is used for store credit?
R7/R8: Must all retries finish inside the 5-minute window? What is the wait time between retries?
R8: Does 'retries 3 times' mean 4 attempts in total (1 initial + 3 retries)? What fields must the error log entry contain, and is the message ever re-sent after the error log entry?
R8: Does the refund to the customer still complete if the SAP send fails?
R1: Is the original receipt required, or can the refund be looked up by transaction ID or card?
